copy.title: App Toolkit: Your toolkit
copy.headline: App Toolkit. Your toolkit.
copy.description: App Toolkit for Android opens into live tools for direction, measuring, counting and everyday choices. Watch the toolbox become your toolkit in one app.
copy.longDescription: The original App Toolkit mark opens as a chest and launches four live tools. Large Compass, Level, Flashlight, SOS and Measure close-ups lead to the spinning decision wheel. Three Pixel phones show Quick Tools, Measure and Play & Decide before the final gold burst.
copy.altText: A toolbox opens into live widgets that assemble into App Toolkit's three screens on Pixel phones.
